tasks.behavior: keep the harness queue small and resume instructions current
acceptance: status shows current task state and one correct next action without historical handoff prose or duplicate acceptance and check details; live verification tells the reader to wait and interrupted verification tells them to rerun
show preserves full acceptance, checks and constraints, prints at most three short recent notes by default, and exposes complete notes and check history with --history

show tells the reader when requirement references are missing; workflow directs narrow reading and moves staging instructions into a linked owning document without changing delivery or verification rules

archive moves completed tasks into docs/archive through a command, keeps unfinished and unmerged work in tasks.json, preserves full records and task IDs, and supports historical show/list and reopening without weakening dependency or verification checks
